items.stem: What is the primary purpose of an RDS Multi-AZ deployment?

options.rationale: Correct: Multi-AZ maintains a standby for automatic failover.
Scaling reads is the job of read replicas, not Multi-AZ standby.
Multi-AZ adds a standby and does not reduce cost.

items.explanation: Correct: Multi-AZ maintains a standby for automatic failover.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about RDS backups are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Automated backups enable point-in-time recovery within the retention window
options.rationale: Correct: automated backups plus transaction logs allow PITR.

options.text: Manual snapshots persist until you delete them
options.rationale: Correct: manual snapshots are retained until explicitly removed.

options.text: Backups make a read replica unnecessary
options.rationale: Backups and read replicas serve different purposes.

options.text: Backups automatically make the database Multi-AZ
options.rationale: Backups do not change deployment topology.

items.explanation: Correct: automated backups plus transaction logs allow PITR.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: How should you change an engine configuration setting in RDS?

options.text: Modify a parameter group associated with the instance
options.rationale: Correct: parameter groups manage engine settings in RDS.

options.text: SSH into the host and edit the config file
options.rationale: RDS is managed; host SSH access to edit configs is not available.

options.text: Recreate the instance from scratch each time

options.rationale: Backups do not hold live engine configuration.

items.explanation: Correct: parameter groups manage engine settings in RDS.
